name: Pexels AI
description: Adds AI-agent functionality to search/fetch Pexels stock media into Drupal media.
project_description:
This project offers different plugins to make use of Pexels for agents.

 Soon to come is also Automators.

 Features 
 Function calls to search and download from Pexels into Media entities.

 Post-Installation 
 
 Install the module. 
 Set the config under /admin/config/pexels_ai/settings 
 The tools should be available to use 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 This needs the Media module installed and the AI Agents to use the function calls.

 
 AI Disclosure. 
 Note that extensive parts of this module, including the API connector and its interfaces was generating via AI coding agents.
